subject: SkyBridge integration milestones & evaluation schedule
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditi Rao <aditi@skybridge.ai>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@skybridge.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: SkyBridge integration milestones & evaluation schedule

Hi Aditi / Tom,

Following our demo last week, attaching an updated mutual action plan (MAP) and proposed evaluation timeline for the API/SDK integration track.

Highlights & asks:
- SDK integration (week 1-2): complete sample auth flow and run basic generate + streaming tests
- Auth & token exchange: confirm support for your existing OAuth proxy by 3/9
- Streaming & tool-calling (week 3): validate chunked responses and tool invocation
- Evaluation plan: shared prompt set + automated regression harness by 3/16

Attached: SkyBridge_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP w/ milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria)

Proposed next steps: quick sync Wed 3/4 to pick owners for streaming tests and agree on test accounts.

Action items I'm tracking in the sheet. Ping me if you want a different cadence.

Thanks,
Sean
Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SkyBridge_MAP_v3.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)]

From: Aditi Rao <aditi@skybridge.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@skybridge.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SkyBridge integration milestones & evaluation schedule

Sean—thanks for the PR and MAP. Quick confirmations:
- We can provision test client credentials by 3/5.
- OAuth proxy: Tom will validate compatibility; target 3/9 is OK but if any blocker we'll flag earlier.
- Streaming: we need a short spec from you on expected chunk sizes and error semantics.

Can we do Wed 3/4 10am PT? If yes we'll loop in an engineer (Lena) for the sync.

—Aditi
Head of Platform, SkyBridge AI

From: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@skybridge.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Aditi Rao <aditi@skybridge.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SkyBridge integration milestones & evaluation schedule

On Mon, Mar 2, 2026 at 11:12 AM Aditi Rao <aditi@skybridge.ai> wrote:
> OAuth proxy: Tom will validate compatibility; target 3/9 is OK but if any blocker we'll flag earlier.

I've started a quick compatibility run this morning. Early note: our proxy rewrites Authorization headers for GETs but preserves POST bodies. Could you confirm whether Redwood's SDK retries on 401 vs 403 and whether the token exchange requires any non-standard headers?

I'll upload logs if I hit a blocker.

Thanks,
Tom
Senior Engineer, SkyBridge AI
[Attachment: proxy_headers_sample.txt (text)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditi Rao <aditi@skybridge.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@skybridge.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SkyBridge integration milestones & evaluation schedule — sync notes

Thanks everyone for the sync. Notes and agreed items below.

Meeting notes (Wed 3/4 10:00am PT):
- Attendees: Sean, Monica, Grace, Aditi, Tom, Lena (SkyBridge eng)
- Confirmed test credentials by 3/5; Lena will provision client ID/secret
- Tom to run proxy compatibility checks; Redwood to confirm retry semantics
- Streaming spec: Redwood to share short doc outlining chunking, resend, and end-of-stream markers
- Tool-calling: SkyBridge asked for a sample tool manifest; Redwood to provide example

Action items (owner — due):
1) Share streaming spec + sample code (Grace) — due 2026-03-06
2) Confirm SDK retry behavior on 401/403 and token header expectations (Sean + Eng) — due 2026-03-06
3) SkyBridge to provision test credentials and a sandbox bot user (Lena/Tom) — due 2026-03-05
4) Run early API smoke tests and share logs (Tom) — ongoing, first tranche by 2026-03-08
5) Populate MAP sheet with test accounts and acceptance checks (Sean) — due 2026-03-06

Attachments referenced:
- Streaming_spec_v1.md (to follow)
- SkyBridge_MAP_v3.xlsx (updated)

I'll update the HubSpot deal with the completed items and push updated MAP.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: meeting_minutes_20260304.txt (text)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditi Rao <aditi@skybridge.ai>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@skybridge.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SkyBridge integration milestones & evaluation schedule — updated MAP

Thanks team — quick status update heading into the weekend.

Summary (as of 2026-03-06):
- Test credentials: received (Lena) — verified basic auth flow
- Streaming spec: attached (short doc) — see section 'chunking' for expected behaviour
- SDK retry behaviour: Redwood SDK will retry once on 401 after token refresh; will not retry on 403. SDK team will add explicit header check for 'x-forwarded-auth' by 3/9.
- Early smoke tests: Tom uploaded proxy logs; minor header rewrite issue identified — Tom will patch server-side.

Updated ask: please review the MAP acceptance column and add any missing test cases by EOD 3/08 so we can begin automated regressions on 3/09.

Attachment: SkyBridge_MAP_v3.xlsx (now includes owners & acceptance criteria)
Next checkpoint: weekly MAP sync next Friday 3/13 — unless earlier issues surface.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SkyBridge_MAP_v3.xlsx (Excel, updated)]
